jobDisabled: Reconciliation job is disabled and cannot run automatically.
adapterNotFound: Registered reconciliation source adapter not found.
invalidPeriod: Invalid reconciliation period (periodStart must be earlier than or equal to periodEnd).
discrepancyAlreadyClosed: Reconciliation discrepancy has already been resolved or compensated.
repairHandlerNotFound: Registered data repair handler not found.
repairModeNotSupported: The selected data repair handler does not support the requested action mode.
repairMissingTarget: Either discrepancyId or explicit target entity info (targetEntityType, targetEntityId) is required.
repairDryRunRequired: A valid Dry-Run preview is required before applying a data repair.
repairPendingApprovalRequired: Data repair request is not awaiting approval.
repairApprovalRequired: Sensitive data repair requires independent approval before execution.
repairAlreadyExecuted: Data repair request has already been executed.
repairRejected: Data repair request was rejected and cannot be executed.
selfApprovalForbidden: Self-approval is forbidden: the approver must be a different user from the proposer.
invalidActorForApproval: Unable to resolve authenticated actor identity for maker-checker verification.
compensationParentInvalid: Compensating action can only be created from an executed repair or non-rollbackable record.
compensationNotSupported: The selected repair handler does not support compensating actions.
paymentsBridgeUnavailable: Payments public service is currently unavailable for bridge reconciliation or compensation.
paymentsTransactionMissing: Target payment transaction was not found for preview or compensating action.
invalidCsvInput: Invalid reconciliation CSV payload or missing record key column (recordKey / paymentCode).
